title: Returning Something You Bought
meta: B2 · 约 310 词 · 场景：商店退换货与无小票退礼物

lines.en: Hi, how can I help you today?
lines.zh: 您好，今天有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: **Hi, I'd like to return this air fryer. It stopped working after just a few days.**
lines.zh: 你好，我想退这台空气炸锅。才用了几天就坏了。

lines.en: Oh no. Do you have the ==receipt== with you?
lines.zh: 哎呀。您带小票了吗？

lines.en: I have the digital receipt in my email. Here it is. I bought it ten days ago.
lines.zh: 邮箱里有电子小票，就这个。我是十天前买的。

lines.en: Thanks. Unfortunately, our ==refund== policy is seven days. After that, it goes back to the manufacturer for repair under ==warranty==.
lines.zh: 谢谢。不过我们的退款期是七天。超过七天就只能走厂家保修维修了。

lines.en: I understand, but it __broke down__ on the third day. I was away on a business trip, so I couldn't bring it in sooner.
lines.zh: 我理解，但它第三天就坏了。我当时出差，所以没法早点拿过来。

lines.en: I see. What exactly is wrong with it?
lines.zh: 明白了。具体是什么问题？

lines.en: It turns on, but it doesn't heat up at all. It's clearly a ==defect==, not something we did.
lines.zh: 能开机，但完全不加热。这明显是质量问题，不是我们弄坏的。

lines.en: Let me __check with my manager__. One moment, please.
lines.zh: 我去问一下经理。请稍等。

lines.en: Okay, my manager says we can make an ==exception== and swap it for a new one today.
lines.zh: 好的，经理说可以破例，今天给您换一台新的。

lines.en: **That would be great. Could you test the new one before I take it home?**
lines.zh: 太好了。我带回家之前，能先把新的试一下吗？

lines.en: While I'm here, my son got this toy as a gift, but he already has the same one. It's ==unopened==.
lines.zh: 趁我在这儿，我儿子收到这个玩具当礼物，可他已经有一个一样的了。还没拆封。

lines.en: Do you have a gift receipt, by any chance?
lines.zh: 请问您有礼品小票吗？

lines.en: No, I'm afraid not. Is there any way you could still take it back?
lines.zh: 恐怕没有。还有什么办法能退吗？

lines.en: Without a receipt, I can only offer ==store credit== at the current selling price.
lines.zh: 没有小票的话，我只能按现价给您退成店内消费额度。

lines.en: **Would it be possible to put it back on my card instead?**
lines.zh: 能不能直接退到我的卡上？

lines.en: Sorry, card refunds need ==proof of purchase==. But the credit is valid for a year, and you can use it online too.
lines.zh: 抱歉，退到卡上需要购买凭证。不过额度一年内有效，网上也能用。

lines.en: Okay, store credit is fine then. How much is it worth?
lines.zh: 好吧，那消费额度也行。值多少钱？

lines.en: It's on ==promotion== right now, so it's thirty-two ninety.
lines.zh: 它现在在促销，所以是三十二块九。

lines.en: Oh, but it was bought at full price. __Is there anything you can do__?
lines.zh: 哦，可这是原价买的。能想想办法吗？

lines.en: Let me see. I'll __go ahead and__ give you the full price, thirty-nine ninety. Just this once.
lines.zh: 我看看。那我就按原价给您，三十九块九。就这一次。

lines.en: That's really kind of you. Thanks for all your help.
lines.zh: 你真好。谢谢你帮了这么多。

gist.q: 空气炸锅出了什么问题？为什么不能直接退款？
gist.a: 能开机但完全不加热；买了十天，超过了七天退款期，按规定只能走厂家保修。

gist.q: 「你」怎么说服店员？最后怎么处理的？
gist.a: 说明第三天就坏了、当时在出差、明显是质量问题；经理破例当天换一台新的，「你」还要求先试机。

gist.q: 没有小票的玩具最后怎么退的？
gist.a: 不能退到卡上，只能退成店内消费额度；「你」指出是原价买的，店员破例按原价三十九块九给额度。

prompts.q: 你网购的儿童鞋尺码不对，到线下门店想换。说明情况，问能不能在店里换，以及没货怎么办。
prompts.ref: Hi, I bought these shoes for my son on your website last week, but they're a size too small. He's only tried them on indoors. Can I exchange them here in the store, or do I have to send them back by post? And if you don't have the next size in stock, could I get a refund instead?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我上周在你们官网给儿子买了这双鞋，但小了一码。他只在家里试穿过。能在门店直接换吗，还是必须寄回去？如果大一码没货，可以改成退款吗？

prompts.q: 你买的衬衫洗了一次就掉色，但店员说洗过的不能退。礼貌而坚定地争取，并要求见经理。
prompts.ref: I understand you normally don't accept washed items, but I followed the care label exactly. I washed it once in cold water, and the colour came out all over my other clothes. That's a quality problem, not something I did wrong. If you're not able to help, could I please speak to the manager?
prompts.ref_zh: 我理解洗过的东西你们一般不退，但我完全是按洗涤标签操作的。只用冷水洗了一次，颜色就掉得我其他衣服上都是。这是质量问题，不是我操作不当。如果你没法处理，能请经理来一下吗？

words.ex: Do you need a printed receipt, or is an email okay?
I asked for a refund because the shoes were too small.
The laptop comes with a two year warranty.
If there's a defect, they'll replace it for free.
Normally we don't allow food inside, but we'll make an exception.
You can return unopened items within thirty days.
They gave me store credit instead of cash.
Keep your proof of purchase for warranty claims.
The supermarket has a promotion on durian this week.
Our washing machine broke down again.
